about_the_game:
all content presented is from currently in-development builds and subject to change

WHAT IS CULT OF ICARUS?

Cult of Icarus is a methodical, mythological, brutal top-down shooter, inspired by the likes of Hotline Miami and Faith: The Unholy Trinity. Bestowed with the ancient, holy technology of the ANGEL unit, enact zealous revenge against the arch-enemy of the Lord, who are surely equally as bent on your destruction as you are theirs. Harvest your enemies for cybernetics or simply to heal yourself, eliminate the occult members with vicarious prejudice, and slowly uncover the story of Icarus...and the story of You.

HOW DO I ELIMINATE THE ARCH-ENEMY OF THE TRUE LORD?

The New Commandments Of The True God - Dated 20XX

COMMANDMENT V - THOU SHALT KILL 

Eliminate the enemies of the LORD with precision and skill. Using a variety of weaponry, cleanse the realm of their filth. Dodge, weave, and shoot your way out of any situation. There is no better way out than the sword. Especially that of one blessed by the one true LORD GOD. 

COMMANDMENT VII - THOU SHALT DELIVER

The mission you are set out upon sits above all. Weather the storm, lick your wounds, and punch back harder than before. Bear upon the monsters and heretics of the dark, only the pain and destruction that you can bring as an ANGEL of the LORD GOD. Eliminate them all, and live to do it again. For thou are damned, so bring them with you. 

COMMANDMENT X - REMEMBER THY BODY AND KEEP IT LETHAL

HARVEST your enemies for their heretical cybernetics, to enhance your own killing power. Defeating enemies gives you an opportunity to harvest such offenses to the LORD, or simply liquidate them to replenish your own bleeding and broken body. Your ANGEL unit allows quick-swapping of cybernetics depending on your circumstances, but it comes at its own price in blood. 

COMMANDMENT I - THOU SHALT DIE

Thou are damned. It is inescapable. It is inevitable. Redemption comes at a cost and well...it just wasn't particularly worth it in your case. And so you became an ANGEL of the LORD. Bringer of death. Harbinger of a redemption you yourself will never feel. And so you will die. (probably a lot.) But death is not damnation, for death is far from something you have earned.  

--------------------------------------------------------------

By The LORD GOD'S Command: KILL THEM ALL.

--------------------------------------------------------------

-Chapter One currently slated to be available at launch, but depending on community feedback, Cult of Icarus may launch instead with all 3 chapters available. All images and graphics were captured during development, and are subject to change (and probably have.) If chapters are released in batches, do note the price will increase a small amount with each incremental update. More information on the specifics will be out when the release day approaches, however feel free to contact me with any and all questions you have!-

-Riley Coden, Deerskirt Studios

  • Processor: Intel Core i3 Processor or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics card with 512MB RAM and Webgl enabled
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: These requirements are not final

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 Processor or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics card with 4096MB RAM and Webgl enabled
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: These requirements are not final
